lines.zh: 我悬着移动，底下的圈在转。
lines.en: I move hovering while the ring below spins.

lines.zh: 金圈一转，地面就亮一片。
lines.en: One turn of the golden ring and the ground gleams.
I drift forward with a faint chime.
I fly over your head.

lines.zh: 我的金环边缘磨得很亮。
lines.en: The rim of my ring is worn bright.

lines.zh: 我好像总在绕着一个中心转。
lines.en: I always seem to circle some center.
I rise a little to clear the trees.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上是个圆。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is a circle.
I sink slowly to waist height.

lines.zh: 环上一格一格地亮起来。
lines.en: The ring lights up, segment by segment.
I hover as the ring turns slowly.
Gold light runs over me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有环在动。
lines.en: I don't move; only the ring does.
The wind scatters my sound.
I'm waiting for the ring to complete a turn.
There's a small gap in my rim.
The grass below is lit up.
I rise and fall with the air.

lines.zh: 我静静听着自己的响声。
lines.en: I listen to my own chime.
Fine patterns run along the golden ring.
I draw the ring in tighter.
I don't dare come too near the ground.
Light spills off my edge.
I turn my angle slightly.
Wind comes and the ring wobbles.
I float back up higher.
You're standing right underneath me.
Are you thinking of grabbing me?
One rise and you can't reach me.
Your shadow is inside my ring.
I don't touch down; I'd sink if I did.
Can you hear my chime?

lines.zh: 金环在你头顶慢慢收紧。
lines.en: The golden ring tightens above your head.
There's no handle on me.
You shouldn't stand in the center.
I tilt the ring upright.
The golden ring's glow got knocked dim.
The ring has been knocked out of shape.
It took me long to steady.
I lift clear of it.
A mark has appeared on my rim.
My chime has gone dull.
My spin has lost its rhythm.
I'm hanging lower.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记在环上。
lines.en: I've marked your place on my ring.
The gold light wavered a while.
There's gold glinting over there.
I move toward that glint.

lines.zh: 那点金光，和我的环一样。
lines.en: That glimmer matches my ring.
This looks like my ring.
Lift it higher so I can slip my ring around it.
The gold ring spins; I can't slow down.
It might hold my light.
My ring of light glides along the ground.
The sound matches mine.
I've slotted it into my ring.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的边上，声音很响。
lines.en: You hit my rim and it rings loudly.
I spun most of a turn before stopping.
My light is flickering badly.
I rose to get clear of you.
I spun a long while before righting.
The impact pushed you back a step.
We struck an odd note together.
I turn slowly back into place.
I'm lighter than you; wind is enough.
I skim past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 另一个圈从上面落下来。
lines.en: Another ring drifts down from above.

lines.zh: 我们套在一起，金光加倍。
lines.en: We settle into each other and the gold doubles.

lines.zh: 一起转的时候没有声音。
lines.en: Turning together, we make no sound.
We circle the same center.
Two beams become one.

lines.zh: 我把边沿贴上它的边沿。
lines.en: I bring my rim against its rim.
The wind presses us together.
At night our light is bright.
When it turns fast, I turn slower.
At the end we rise together.
I hook it up with my rim.
This thing is quite round.
I press it into the middle of the ring.
Too heavy; I can't lift it.
It slid off my edge.

lines.zh: 我把它套起来，一晃一晃。
lines.en: I loop it on and it sways.
I sink slowly.
Lifting it costs me some effort.
I run my light over it.
I don't need it — here's it back.
My ring is speeding up.
The gold light sweeps over first.
I rise to watch from above.
I widen the ring a little.

lines.zh: 我把身体转到有利的角度。
lines.en: I turn to a better angle.
It's standing on my shadow.
I press slowly downward.
My chime has changed.

lines.zh: 金色的环，就是我冲过来的样子。
lines.en: A golden ring is how I charge.
I close in, circling.
One more turn and I strike.
I've spread the ring as wide as it goes.
My circle is right over its head.
The light comes down over it.
I've sped up my spin.
It goes left; I crowd the left.
My light is blinding it.
I draw the ring as tight as it goes.

lines.zh: 它停在三尺之外，我悬住。
lines.en: It stops three feet off; I hang still.
I've come down bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它想跑，圈已经不够宽了。
lines.en: It wants to run; the circle's too small.
It's panting; I hear it.
I've moved round to face it.
Its hands are shaking.
My ring is glaring bright.
I drop the ring heavily.
It won't get out of this circle.
I pause for half a breath.
It looks up — exactly what I wanted.
I gather the light in.
I drive down at it.

lines.zh: 我整圈撞上去，声音很响。
lines.en: I strike with the whole ring; it rings.
I cut it with my edge.
One flash of gold and it's back-pedaling.

lines.zh: 我压下去，把它压在中间。
lines.en: I press down and pin it inside.
That one used the rim.

lines.zh: 它撞在我的圈上，弹开了。
lines.en: It hit my ring and bounced off.
I lift and slam down.
It's sitting on the ground.
I tighten around it.
It's grabbing my rim.
I turn half round and fling it off.
The sound echoes between the trunks.
My second ring-blow lands harder.
It's not getting up.
The gold light comes up from my middle.

lines.zh: 我从半空悬住，没有落地。
lines.en: I hang in the air without landing.

lines.zh: 第一圈旋转的时候有响声。
lines.en: The first turn makes a sound.
The grass all around is lit.
My rim is still warm.
I turn myself upright slowly.
There's a circle of light on the ground.
I rise to the height of the canopy.
The wind tips me slightly.
I've opened the ring.
The air here is dry.
I come down a little at a time.
The light sweeps across the stones.
I stop, and the ring keeps turning.
A shadow passes beneath me.
I drift in that direction.
My chime carries a long way.
The ring blurs into a band of light.

lines.zh: 火烤热了我的环，烫得发红。
lines.en: Fire heats my ring until it glows red.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，砸出一个圆坑。
lines.en: I drop and leave a round crater.

lines.zh: 水一进环里，我就往下沉。
lines.en: Once water's inside the ring, I sink.
The shockwave hurls me far off.

lines.zh: 一支箭从我的环中间穿过去。
lines.en: An arrow passes through the middle of my ring.
A spell circles my rim.
My light keeps fading; I can't hold it.
Lightning strikes the ring and it blazes.

lines.zh: 没有支撑了，我直直坠下。
lines.en: Nothing holds me up; I plummet.
